title: Unlacquered Brass Cabinet Pull, 3 Inch Solid Brass Cabinet Mount Handle, 3.9 X 1.6 X 0.9 In, Allied Brass
description: Cabinet pull for cabinet doors and drawers, sized 3 inches and crafted from solid brass with cabinet mount installation in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. Use as a cabinet pull handle, drawer pull, cabinet handle, or cabinet door pull to refresh kitchen or bathroom cabinetry with a traditional, timeless look (contemporary design with traditional design elements). Dimensions: 3.9 in length x 1.6 in height x 0.9 in width; 1 in projection. Size formats: 3 inches, 3-inch. Includes the cabinet pull and all installation hardware; assembly required: no. Weight capacity: 2 lb. Available in multiple lifetime designer finishes with corrosion-free and rust-free performance and backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Complements traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass.
